title: Monochrome, Good Smile Unveil Ignisphere Mixed Media Project, Along With Project's Dawngazer Action RPG
content:
Monochrome Corp. and Good Smile Company announced a new mixed media IP titled Ignisphere on Friday, along with the first title announced for the franchise , an action RPG titled Dawngazer . Monochrome's Takafumi Noma, the director and character designer of Vanillaware's Unicorn Overlord game, is directing Dawngazer at Ignisphere Studio, with Good Smile Company publishing the game. The companies unveiled a teaser (seen below) for Ignisphere .

The game will launch for Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in 2028, with language support for Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.

Yoshimi Kudō will compose the music for the game, and composed and arranged the music that is featured in the above teaser. KOCHO , SAK ., and Maki Takimoto provided the vocals for the song, and Wataru Mukai played the cello.

Good Smile Company will handle merchandising for the Ignisphere IP. The franchise also has "multiple" light novel projects in development under Kadokawa 's Fujimi Fantasia Bunko novel imprint.

Atlus released Vanillaware and Noma's Unicorn Overlord game for Switch, PS5, PlayStation 4, and Xbox Series X|S in March 2024 worldwide.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 New Trailer Previews Ending Song by Eve
content:
The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 revealed a new trailer and ending theme song by Eve ahead of its October 2, 2026 premiere. The anime will lead up to the upcoming movie , which will premiere in Japan on December 11 with an original story by the author Natsu Hyuuga. The second cour of Season 3 is scheduled for April 2027.

The anime previously revealed a teaser featuring the opening theme song “Kumo wo Nuke Kazashimo e Watashi Dake” by Yorushika. Studio OLM is back to handle the animation production, while TOHO animation STUDIO is notably absent from the staff credits list.

You can watch the new trailer featuring “AIYOU” by Eve below.

ALSO READ: The Apothecary Diaries Interview: Aoi Yuki (Maomao) & Takeo Otsuka (Jinshi) Crunchyroll Reveals New York Comic Con 2026 Lineup With The Apothecary Diaries, Sentenced to Be a Hero, Black Clover and More

The main staff was also previously revealed and includes:

• Director: Akinori Fudesaka

• Assistant Director: Wataru Nakagawa

• Series Composition: Norihiro Naganuma

• Scripts: Yuko Kakihara, Misuzu Chiba, Hitomi Ogawa

• Character Design: Yukiko Nakatani

• Art Director: Katsumi Takao

• Color Design: Misato Aida, Nanako Okazaki

• CGI Director: Tamotsu Nagai

• Director of Photography: Mayo Suzuki

• Editing: Daisuke Imai

• Sound Director: Shoji Hata

• Music: Satoru Kosaki, Kevin Penkin, Arisa Okehazama

• Animation Production: OLM

You can also see the key visual:

Natsu Hyuga writes the The Apothecary Diaries light novel, with illustrations by Toko Shino. The series is serialized by Shunfunotomo. The series has 2 manga adaptations, one written by Itsuki Nanao and illustrated by Nekokurage, and one written and illustrated by Minoji Kurata.

J-Novel Club is publishing the novel in English, while Squre Enix is publishing the manga. The story follows Maomao, a young apothecary who ends up getting sold to the emperor’s palace as a lowly servant. She’s not the type of character who can just stay obedient, so she ends up helping Jinshi, the handsome official at the palace.

The franchise recently also announced its first live-action series adaptation , as well as the first console game . The Failure at God School , a manga with story written by Natsu Hyuga, also recently announced an anime adaptation .

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Anime's 2nd Trailer Reveals Eve's Ending Theme
content:
TOHO animation began streaming a new trailer for the third season of the anime based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series on Friday. The video reveals Eve will perform the anime's ending theme song "AIYOU."

The third season will air on October 2 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT) in the "Friday Anime Night" programming block on NTV and 29 affiliated channels for its first cours (quarter of a year), and its second cours will premiere in April 2027.

Reina Ueda joins the third season's cast as Bai Niangniang, a pale and mysterious nymph.

yorushika will perform the third season's opening theme song "Kumo o Nukekazashimo e Watashidake" (I Am Alone, Breaking Through the Clouds Downwind).

The franchise also has the upcoming Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ( The Apothecary Diaries : The Deceased Empress' Treasure) film , which will open in theaters on December 11 and feature a brand-new story by the original novel series' author Hyuganatsu . The franchise also has an upcoming live-action series that will debut on Amazon Prime Video worldwide in 2028.

The anime's first season premiered in October 2023 with the first three episodes, and aired for two cours (quarters of a year). Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan and is also streaming an English dub .

The second anime season premiered in January 2025 on Nippon TV 's FRIDAY ANIME NIGHT programming block, and aired for two consecutive cours . Crunchyroll is streaming the second season, and it is also streaming an English dub .

J-Novel Club publishes the novel series digitally, and it describes the story:

In the East is a land ruled by an emperor, whose consorts and serving women live in a sprawling complex known as the hougong, the rear palace. Maomao, an unassuming girl raised in an unassuming town by her apothecary father, never imagined the rear palace would have anything to do with her—until she was kidnapped and sold into service there. Though she looks ordinary, Maomao has a quick wit, a sharp mind, and an extensive knowledge of medicine. That's her secret, until she encounters a resident of the palace at least as perceptive as she is: the head eunuch, Jinshi. He sees through Maomao's façade and makes her a lady-in-waiting to none other than the Emperor's favorite consort... so she can taste the lady's food for poison!

Hyuganatsu began serializing the story on the "Shōsetsuka ni Narō" (Let's Become Novelists) website in October 2011. Shufunotomo began publishing the novels in print volume with illustrations by Shino in August 2014. Nekokurage launched an ongoing manga adaptation in Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine in May 2017. Square Enix Manga & Books is releasing the manga adaptation in English. The company is also publishing the novels in print. Viz Media is releasing Minoji Kurata 's separate The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao’s Notes on the Inner Palace manga adaptation in print.
author: ANN

title: 'Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen 2nd Season Part 2' Announces Additional Cast, Character Promo
content:
The official website of the Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ( Mission: Yozakura Family ) television anime announced additional cast members for its second part of second season on Friday. The second part is scheduled to premiere on October 11 at 5.00 p.m. on MBS/TBS Network, followed by BS Nippon Television and AT-X on October 21.

Cast Alexandre: Houchuu Ootsuka ( Sakamoto Days ) Shura: Miku Itou ( Nekopara ) Cyber Demon King "G": Yumiri Hanamori ( Gachiakuta ) Dr. Mozu: Sumire Uesaka ( Overlord ) Koro: Naomi Shindou ( No Game No Life )

Takahiro Nakatsugawa ( Ragna Crimson animation director) returns to direct the second cour at SILVER LINK. , with Mirai Minato ( Masamune-kun no Revenge ) as director and series composition. Mizuki Takahashi ( Uramichi Oniisan ) is designing the characters.

Produced by Silver Link. , the first season adapting Hitsuji Gondaira 's action comedy manga aired in April 2024. The first part of the second season aired in Spring 2026. Hulu streamed the series with subtitles and later with an English dub, while Disney+ streamed it worldwide.

Gondaira serialized the manga in Weekly Shounen Jump from August 2019 to January 2025. Shueisha published the 29th and final volume in March 2025. Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen has a cumulative 3.6 million copies of its volumes in circulation.

VIZ Media and Shueisha simulpublished the manga in English on its Manga Plus app and website. The former also releases the manga in physical format and shipped the 24th volume on August 18. The 25th volume is planned for an October 20 release.

title: Duel Masters Lost: Danzai no Shōnen Anime Reveals More Cast, Ending Theme in Main Promo Video
content:
The staff for the Duel Masters LOST anime series revealed the main promotional video on Friday for the anime's fourth part , Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy).

The above video reveals and previews Tsukuyomi 's ending theme song "Tuitachi feat. Yoshino ."

The staff also revealed two more cast members:

Masaya Matsukaze as Murasaki, a man called "the street duel legend"

Yurika Kubo as Hiyo Moriguchi, a girl who appears before Win and others.

The anime will debut on October 9. The series will have four episodes, and will stream on the Duel Masters official YouTube channel and other services. New episodes will debut every other week on Fridays at 9:00 p.m. JST.

The anime will feature a returning cast. Nina Tamaki will voice the character Lost Kōzaki (name romanization not confirmed). Tamaki previously voiced a "mysterious boy" in the previous anime.

Riki Fukushima is returning to direct the new anime at J.C. Staff and SMDE , with animation production supervision by Yūji Matsukura . Yōichi Katō is returning to oversee the series scripts. Chikara Hashizume is returning to design the characters, and Go Sakabe is returning to compose the music.

Based on the long-running Duel Masters trading card game, Yō Kanebayashi and Shigenobu Matsumoto 's Duel Masters LOST Tsuioku no Suishō ( Duel Masters LOST: Crystal of Remembrance) manga launched in February 2024 and ended in March 2024. Kanebayashi and Matsumoto then launched the Duel Masters LOST ~Gekka no Shinigami~ ( Duel Masters LOST: Reaper of the Moon) manga in August 2024, and ended it in February 2025. Duel Masters LOST ~Bōkyaku no Taiyō~ , the third part of the manga, debuted in September 2025.

Duel Masters LOST ~Danzai no Shōnen~ (The Sentencing Boy), the fourth part , debuted on March 26, and ended on July 2. The manga's fifth part, titled "Shitsuraku no Duel," debuted on September 17.

The net anime adaptation of Duel Masters LOST Tsuioku no Suishō debuted in October 2024 and had four episodes. The anime of Duel Masters LOST ~Gekka no Shinigami~ debuted in December 2024 and ended with its fourth and final episode in February 2025.

The anime of Duel Masters LOST ~Bōkyaku no Taiyō~ debuted on February 6 with a four-episode streaming run.

title: Mission: Yozakura Family Season 2 Part 2's Video Reveals 5 Cast Members
content:
The staff for the anime of Hitsuji Gondaira 's Mission: Yozakura Family ( Yozakura-san Chi no Daisakusen ) manga revealed a new promotional video for the anime on Friday. The video reveals five new cast members for the anime.

The new cast members include:

Hōchū Ōtsuka as Alexandryu

Miku Itō as Shura

Yumiri Hanamori as Cyber Demon Lord Giga

Sumire Uesaka as Dr. Mozu

Naomi Shindoh as Hulang

The announcement also revealed the character Kosmos Akizakura (seen below), but did not reveal the voice actor for the character.

The second part of the second season will premiere on MBS , TBS , and 26 other channels on October 11 at 5:00 p.m. (4:00 a.m. EDT).

Disney describes the anime's story:

High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

For the current season, Mirai Minato is now the chief director of the anime at SILVER LINK , and is again overseeing the series scripts. Takahiro Nakatsugawa , who worked as a storyboard artist and episode director on the first season, is directing the anime. Other returning staff includes character designer Mizuki Takahashi , composer Kōji Fujimoto , and sound director Tōru Kanegae .

The second season premiered on April 12 on MBS , TBS , and 26 other affiliated channels during the "Nichigo" programming block, which runs on Sundays at 5:00 p.m. JST (4:00 a.m. EDT). Hulu streams the new season. The second season's first part ended with the anime's overall 39th episode on June 28.

The first season premiered in Japan in April 2024 on MBS , TBS , and 26 of their affiliate channels. Disney streams the anime through the Hulu service with an English dub in the United States. The series also streams on Prime Video and Netflix in Japan.

Gondaira ( Demon Prince Poro's Diaries ) launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in August 2019. The manga ended its serialization in January 2025. Shueisha published the 29th and final compiled book volume in March 2025.

Viz Media simultaneously published the manga in English digitally since its debut in Japan. Viz Media then began publishing volumes digitally in December 2020, and began releasing the series physically starting with the first volume in October 2022. Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service also released the manga digitally in English.

The franchise also includes several novels.
author: ANN

title: Chizuna Nakajima's Where is the Elf Teacher's Toilet? Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
Kadokawa announced on Friday that Chizuna Nakajima 's Elf-Sensei no Toire wa Doko Desu ka? ( Where is the Elf Teacher's Toilet? ) manga is getting a television anime adaptation.

Nakajima drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement:

The story revolves around the elf teaching trainee Eruru, who has come from another world. She finds she can only relieve herself in the lush forest.

Nakajima launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Comic Cune magazine in January 2024. The manga will resume serialization on Saturday.

Kadokawa published the first compiled volume of the manga in July 2024, and published the second volume in February 2025.

Nakajima launched the Jitensha no Onee-san (The Bicycle Lady) manga in Comic Cune in September 2019 and ended it in September 2020. Kadokawa published two volumes for the manga.

Nakajima launched the Angel's Drop ( Tenshi no Drop ) comedy manga on Holp Shuppan 's Flex Comix Blood site in 2011, but after Flex Comix Blood shut down a year later, the manga moved to the Comic Meteor website. The manga ended in December 2013. The manga inspired a television anime special from director Kōji Itō and the anime studio AIC Frontier in 2013.

title: The Fake Alchemist Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, Staff
content:
Kadokawa unveiled a new teaser trailer for the television anime of storywriter Jirō Sugiura and artist Umemaru 's The Fake Alchemist ( Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi ) manga on Friday. The teaser announces the anime's cast and staff.

The anime stars Yōhei Matsuoka as Paracelsus and Miyari Nemoto as Nora.

Takeo Takahashi ( Wasteful Days of High School Girl , Hinako Note , Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf ) is the chief director, while Hijiri Sanpei ( Yuri Is My Job! , Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf ) is the director. Kenta Ihara ( Saga of Tanya the Evil , Ishura , Nukitashi the Animation ) is in charge of the series scripts. Yuka Takashina ( D.C.S.S. ~Da Capo Second Season~ , Dance with Devils , Ishura ) is designing the characters. Luke Standridge ( An Observation Log of My Fiancée Who Calls Herself a Villainess , Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized! ) is composing the music.

Kadokawa describes the story:

As an indie hit that became a legendary sensation, surpassing 1 million copies in its commercial edition in Japan, this new monumental “isekai” finally gets a TV adaptation! In the city-state of Orichalconia, a world where alchemy and magic are deeply rooted in the lives of the people, the reincarnated Paracelsus ekes out a living as an alchemist while hiding his “cheat skills”. However, his life changes dramatically one day after he enters into a contract with a shaman slave-girl, Nora, and later meets Coco, an elf who has lost all four limbs and five senses. To save Coco, what began as a rescue attempt in a small workshop gradually escalates into a battle involving alchemy and sorcery, space and even the gods themselves— The curtain now rises on this story, filled to the brim with “everything fantasy”! Passione is animating the series.

Sugiura and Umemaru launched the manga on Kadokawa 's KadoComi website in June 2023. The manga is ongoing, and Kadokawa released the fifth compiled book volume on February 20. Kadokawa is releasing the manga in English digitally. Yen Press releases the manga in print, with the second volume scheduled for release on June 23.

Sugiura launched the My Wife Has No Emotion manga in Kadokawa 's Comic Flapper magazine in 2019, although the manga has been on hiatus since November 2024. Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga in English. The manga's television anime adaptation premiered in July 2024.

title: Red River Anime Posts New Video for 2nd Part
content:
The official website for the television anime of Chie Shinohara 's Red River ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ) shōjo manga unveiled the full promotional video and the main visual for the anime's second part on Friday. The video previews the anime's new opening theme song "Akatsuki no Hoshi" (Morning Star) by Nana Mizuki .

Viz Media describes how the manga's story begins:

Yuri, a pretty Japanese girl, is ecstatic after passing her college entrance exam and having her first kiss with her childhood friend-turned boyfriend. However, her luck soon changes. She starts to notice that water becomes agitated whenever she goes near it. One night, hands appear out of a puddle on the street and drag her into the water! Transported to an ancient village in the Middle East, she is then captured by armed troops and taken to the Queen's palace for a human sacrifice.

The cast includes:

• Mirai Tachibana as Yuri

• Wataru Katō as Kail Muršili (later King Muršili II)

• Aya Uchida as Queen Nakia, the queen of the Hittite Empire

• Shōya Chiba as Zannanza Hattušili, the fourth-born prince of the Hittite Empire

• Tomoaki Maeno as Ilbani, Prince Kail's aide and advisor

• Kōji Yusa as Urhi, Nakia's servant

• Kōsuke Toriumi as Prince Mattiwaza, the Prince of Darkness of the chariot-riding Mitanni kingdom

• Tomohiro Ōno as Kikkuri, Prince Kail's servant

• Shiki Aoki as Hadi, a daughter of the Hatti clan, servant of Kail, and elder sister to Ryui and Shala

• Natsumi Kawaida as Ryui and Misato Matsuoka as Shala, Hadi's younger twin sisters

• Haruki Ishiya as Kash, the leader of the Hittite chariot corps

• Junya Enoki as Rusafa, the leader of the Hittite archer corps

• Shinichirō Kamio as Mittannamuwa, the leader of the Hittite infantry corps

• Sōma Saitō as User Ramses, Kail's greatest rival

• Shun Horie as Juda Haspasrupi, the sixth prince in line for the Hittite throne

Nana Mizuki also joins the cast as Ursula, a false goddess impersonating Ishtar.

Ryu Matsuyama performs the new ending theme song "flow feat. Yūko Andō ."

Kōsuke Kobayashi ( Waccha PriMagi! , Alice or Alice ) is directing the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Yoriko Tomita ( The Elusive Samurai , My Dress-Up Darling ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Kenji Fujisaki ( YU-NO: A girl who chants love at the bound of this world. , Blood Lad ) is designing the characters. Yoshihisa Hirano is composing the music, while Hiroto Morishita is the sound director. Team Kawadon is credited for sound production.

Historical researchers include Kimiyoshi Matsumura and Daisuke Yoshida , who are members of the Japanese Institute of Anatolian Archaeology as part of the Middle Eastern Culture Center in Japan.

The anime premiered in NTV 's "AnichU" programming block on July 7 at 25:35 (effectively, July 8 at 1:35 a.m.), and on BS NTV on July 8. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

Viz Media started releasing the manga in English in 2004, and released all 28 volumes between 2004 to 2010. The company then started re-releasing the manga in 3-in-1 omnibus editions in October 2024, and released the eighth omnibus volume on July 21.

Shinohara originally serialized the manga from 1995 to 2002 in Shogakukan 's Shōjo Comic ( Sho-Comi ) magazine.

The manga inspired a stage play by the famed all-female Takarazuka Revue troupe in 2018.

title: 'Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Teaser Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Jirou Sugiura and Umemaru 's Nisemono no Renkinjutsushi ( The Fake Alchemist ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, and a teaser promotional video on Friday.

Voice actors Youhei Matsuoka ( Fujimoto Tatsuki 17-26 ) and Miyari Nemoto ( Ruri no Houseki ) are starring as Paracelsus and Nora Petan, respectively.

Staff Chief Director: Takeo Takahashi ( Ookami to Koushinryou: Merchant Meets the Wise Wolf ) Director: Hijiri Sanpei ( Watashi no Yuri wa Oshigoto desu! ) Series Composition: Kenta Ihara ( Yuusha-kei ni Shosu: Choubatsu Yuusha 9004-tai Keimu Kiroku ) Character Design: Yuka Takashina ( Ameku Takao no Suiri Karte ) Music: Luke Standridge ( Jishou Akuyaku Reijou na Konyakusha no Kansatsu Kiroku. ) Studio: Passione

Sugiura originally began drawing the fantasy isekai series on pixiv in February 2020. Kadokawa began serializing the manga on its ComicWalker web service in June 2023 and released the first volume in January 2024. The fifth volume was published on February 20.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in August 2025 and shipped the second volume on June 23.

The series ranked 12th in the web manga category of the Next Manga Award 2022.
